operators.protocol: Complete static maximum-shape operations; three independent warm rounds, twenty alternating-order pairs/round,100 graph repetitions/sample. External timing events inside each graph exclude host submission gaps. No profiler during timing. Fixtures use immutable sources and repeatable destinations. DSpark append shares one cache after independent-cache verification. Stateless Q/K timing uses matching output-address sequences in one graph pool after independent verification; whole functions keep their output allocations. Other mutable destinations remain isolated. Before timing, compare both backends' returns and written cache/state slots at existing tolerances.

# traffic traffic=gmem:r27567616/w25847040@total,r27567616/w25847040@cta;rmem:r8/w0@total,r8/w0@cta

from __future__ import annotations

from tilefoundry import func
from tilefoundry.dsl import Tensor
from tilefoundry.dsl.tf import *  # noqa: F401, F403

@func
def gated_norm_fp8_linear(
    x: Tensor[(2, 48, 128), "bf16"],
    gamma: Tensor[(128,), "f32"],
    gate: Tensor[(2, 48, 128), "bf16"],
    weight: Tensor[(256, 6144), "fp8e4m3"],
    weight_scale: Tensor[(2, 48), "f32"]
) -> Tensor[(2, 256), "bf16"]:
    v0 = cast(x, dtype="f32")  # Tensor[(2, 48, 128), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:12288@logical,12288@total,12288@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r24576/w49152@total,r24576/w49152@cta; roofline ideal-ns=10 bound-by=memory
    v1 = unary(v0, kind="square")  # Tensor[(2, 48, 128), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:12288@logical,12288@total,12288@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r49152/w49152@total,r49152/w49152@cta; roofline ideal-ns=13 bound-by=memory
    v2 = reduce(v1, axes=(-1,), keepdim=True, kind="mean")  # Tensor[(2, 48, 1), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:12288@logical,12288@total,12288@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r49152/w384@total,r49152/w384@cta; roofline ideal-ns=7 bound-by=memory
    v0_2 = 1e-06  # Tensor[(), "f32", "umat"]
    v3 = add(v2, v0_2)  # Tensor[(2, 48, 1), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:96@logical,96@total,96@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r384/w384@total,r384/w384@cta;rmem:r4/w0@total,r4/w0@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v4 = unary(v3, kind="rsqrt")  # Tensor[(2, 48, 1), "f32"]; compute-cost other-ops=special:96@logical,96@total,96@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r384/w384@total,r384/w384@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=memory
    v5 = mul(v0, v4)  # Tensor[(2, 48, 128), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:12288@logical,12288@total,12288@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r49536/w49152@total,r49536/w49152@cta; roofline ideal-ns=13 bound-by=memory
    v6 = mul(v5, gamma)  # Tensor[(2, 48, 128), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:12288@logical,12288@total,12288@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r49664/w49152@total,r49664/w49152@cta; roofline ideal-ns=13 bound-by=memory
    v7 = cast(gate, dtype="f32")  # Tensor[(2, 48, 128), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:12288@logical,12288@total,12288@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r24576/w49152@total,r24576/w49152@cta; roofline ideal-ns=10 bound-by=memory
    v8 = silu(v7)  # Tensor[(2, 48, 128), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:12288@logical,12288@total,12288@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r49152/w49152@total,r49152/w49152@cta; roofline ideal-ns=13 bound-by=memory
    v9 = mul(v6, v8)  # Tensor[(2, 48, 128), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:12288@logical,12288@total,12288@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r98304/w49152@total,r98304/w49152@cta; roofline ideal-ns=20 bound-by=memory
    v10 = cast(v9, dtype="bf16")  # Tensor[(2, 48, 128), "bf16"]; compute-cost flops=bf16:12288@logical,12288@total,12288@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r49152/w24576@total,r49152/w24576@cta; roofline ideal-ns=10 bound-by=memory
    v11 = cast(v10, dtype="f32")  # Tensor[(2, 48, 128), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:12288@logical,12288@total,12288@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r24576/w49152@total,r24576/w49152@cta; roofline ideal-ns=10 bound-by=memory
    v12 = reshape(v11, new_shape=(2, 48, 128))  # Tensor[(2, 48, 128), "f32"]; compute-cost; traffic; roofline
    v13 = reduce(v12, axes=(-1,), keepdim=True, kind="abs_max")  # Tensor[(2, 48, 1), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:12288@logical,12288@total,12288@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r49152/w384@total,r49152/w384@cta; roofline ideal-ns=7 bound-by=memory
    v14 = clamp(v13, min_val=1e-10, max_val=1e999)  # Tensor[(2, 48, 1), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:96@logical,96@total,96@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r384/w384@total,r384/w384@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v1_2 = 448.0  # Tensor[(), "f32", "umat"]
    v15 = div(v14, v1_2)  # Tensor[(2, 48, 1), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:96@logical,96@total,96@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r384/w384@total,r384/w384@cta;rmem:r4/w0@total,r4/w0@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v16 = div(v12, v15)  # Tensor[(2, 48, 128), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:12288@logical,12288@total,12288@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r49536/w49152@total,r49536/w49152@cta; roofline ideal-ns=13 bound-by=memory
    v17 = clamp(v16, min_val=-448.0, max_val=448.0)  # Tensor[(2, 48, 128), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:12288@logical,12288@total,12288@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r49152/w49152@total,r49152/w49152@cta; roofline ideal-ns=13 bound-by=memory
    v18 = cast(v17, dtype="fp8e4m3")  # Tensor[(2, 48, 128), "fp8e4m3"]; compute-cost flops=fp8e4m3:12288@logical,12288@total,12288@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r49152/w12288@total,r49152/w12288@cta; roofline ideal-ns=9 bound-by=memory
    v19 = cast(v18, dtype="f32")  # Tensor[(2, 48, 128), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:12288@logical,12288@total,12288@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r12288/w49152@total,r12288/w49152@cta; roofline ideal-ns=9 bound-by=memory
    v20 = mul(v19, v15)  # Tensor[(2, 48, 128), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:12288@logical,12288@total,12288@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r49536/w49152@total,r49536/w49152@cta; roofline ideal-ns=13 bound-by=memory
    v21 = reshape(v20, new_shape=(2, 6144))  # Tensor[(2, 6144), "f32"]; compute-cost; traffic; roofline
    v22 = cast(weight, dtype="f32")  # Tensor[(256, 6144), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:1572864@logical,1572864@total,1572864@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r1572864/w6291456@total,r1572864/w6291456@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1026 bound-by=memory
    v23 = repeat_interleave(weight_scale, repeats=128, axis=0)  # Tensor[(256, 48), "f32"]; compute-cost; traffic traffic=gmem:r384/w49152@total,r384/w49152@cta; roofline ideal-ns=7 bound-by=memory
    v24 = repeat_interleave(v23, repeats=128, axis=1)  # Tensor[(256, 6144), "f32"]; compute-cost; traffic traffic=gmem:r49152/w6291456@total,r49152/w6291456@cta; roofline ideal-ns=827 bound-by=memory
    v25 = mul(v22, v24)  # Tensor[(256, 6144), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:1572864@logical,1572864@total,1572864@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r12582912/w6291456@total,r12582912/w6291456@cta; roofline ideal-ns=2461 bound-by=memory
    v26 = transpose(v25, perm=(1, 0))  # Tensor[(6144, 256), "f32"]; compute-cost; traffic traffic=gmem:r6291456/w6291456@total,r6291456/w6291456@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1641 bound-by=memory
    v27 = matmul(v21, v26, a_layout="MK", b_layout="KN")  # Tensor[(2, 256), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:6291456@logical,6291456@total,6291456@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r6340608/w2048@total,r6340608/w2048@cta; roofline ideal-ns=827 bound-by=memory
    v28 = cast(v27, dtype="bf16")  # Tensor[(2, 256), "bf16"]; compute-cost flops=bf16:512@logical,512@total,512@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r2048/w1024@total,r2048/w1024@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    return v28
